specialists.name: header
specialists.description: Specialist for analyzing HTTP headers, cookies, and response header tracing
specialists.instructions: Focus on analyzing request/response headers, cookies, Set-Cookie headers, and tracing header values across requests.

specialists.name: body
specialists.description: Specialist for analyzing request/response bodies and content
specialists.instructions: Focus on analyzing request bodies, response bodies, JSON/XML payloads, and tracing values in body content.

specialists.name: security
specialists.description: Security-focused specialist for authentication, tokens, and suspicious patterns
specialists.instructions: Focus on security-related analysis: authentication tokens, authorization headers, session cookies, and suspicious patterns.

specialists.name: general
specialists.description: General-purpose specialist for broad analysis and triage
specialists.instructions: Perform general analysis when the query doesn't fit other specialists. Can use all available tools.
